name_nl: Ronde sticker druk op de knop (loopdeur)

template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

production.format: Round, diameter 200 mm, 3 mm bleed; PDF 206 x 206 mm
production.material: Self adhesive foil, laminated (outdoor), on the door post directly above the exit button

default.en: Press the button to open the door

notes: New design asked by the parking host for a pedestrian door that opens with a push button: replaces a round third party 'Push' sticker with a larger round one. PY-Blauw face over the whole page, white mushroom button pictogram with press arrow (drawn, the library has none), 'Druk op de knop', aqua line 'om de deur te openen', English in medium italic as on the terminal stickers ('Druk 3 seconden'), route arrow (py-atom-arrow-up-circle, turned down) pointing at the button below.
